Bill.BriefDescription: Describing how medical test sites must calculate glomerular filtration rates.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the calculation of glomerular filtration ratewhen testing to diagnose kidney disease; and adding a new section tochapter 70.42 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.42 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A designated test site supervisor must ensure that when the testsite tests a specimen to determine a patient's serum creatinine level,the test site calculates the patient's glomerular filtration rate usinginformation provided by the patient or the health care professionalrequesting the test. The test site must include the patient'sglomerular filtration rate with its report to the patient's health careprofessional.
